requirement.description: Missing proper implementation of flat_map functionality - iterables returned by flat_map functions are not being flattened correctly.
requirement.contract: FlatMap operations must properly flatten iterables returned by the mapping function and yield individual items.

requirement.description: Missing proper implementation of on_start/on_done callback handling for worker lifecycle management.
requirement.contract: on_start and on_done callbacks must be properly executed for each worker with correct parameters and return values.
